description: Declared mutants of the entity-store plan (docs/architecture/entity-store.md, Guard). A mutant is killed only when its check fails with the expected message; every check is a common test (no product test). Run with docs/architecture/plans/time-threads-trace/scripts/run_mutations.py --catalog docs/architecture/plans/entity-store/scripts/mutations.json.

mutants.what: FindEntity treats key 0 as absent (Guard row 1)
mutants.find: return position != last && EntityStore::EntityOf(*position) == id ? position : last;
mutants.replace: return id != 0 && position != last && EntityStore::EntityOf(*position) == id ? position : last;

mutants.what: InsertEntity asserts on 0 as a reserved value (Guard row 1)
InsertEntity appends instead of inserting at the lower_bound position (Guard row 2)
mutants.expect: Entity store insert: the ordered position

mutants.what: EraseEntity moves the last element into the hole (Guard row 2)
mutants.expect: Entity store erase: keeps the order

mutants.what: FindEntity returns the lower_bound element without comparing its key (Guard row 3)
mutants.find: return position != last && EntityStore::EntityOf(*position) == id ? position : last;

mutants.what: The lookup scans the column linearly instead of a binary search (Guard row 3, comparison budget)
mutants.find:
return std::lower_bound(first, last, id,
                            [](const auto& value, EntityId key) { return EntityStore::EntityOf(value) < key; });
mutants.replace: return std::find_if(first, last, [id](const auto& value) { return !(EntityStore::EntityOf(value) < id); });
mutants.expect: Entity store find: a lookup reads at most

mutants.what: InsertEntity no longer asserts on a present key (Guard row 7)
mutants.expect: Entity store insert: a present key

mutants.what: EraseEntity of an absent key fails a GYO_ASSERT instead of returning false (Guard row 7)
mutants.replace:
GYO_ASSERT(position != column.end());
    if (position == column.end()) return false;
mutants.expect: Entity store erase: keeps the order

mutants.what: EntityOf reads the member id directly when there is one instead of going through EntityKey (Guard row 10)
mutants.replace:
if constexpr (requires { value.id; }) return static_cast<EntityId>(value.id);
    else return EntityKey<T>::Of(value);

mutants.what: GYO::EntityStore links GYO::Math (Guard row 9, configure-time link check)
A store header includes an engine/math header (Guard row 9: the test executable cannot compile it)
mutants.expect: engine/math/scalar/Scalar\.hpp.*(file not found|No such file)|Cannot open include file

mutants.what: The store adds a std::unordered_map index (Guard rows 5, 6, 8; word guard W2)
StrictlyAscending keeps a function-local static counter (Guard rows 5, 6, 8; word guard W4)
The store includes <chrono> (Design Invariant 8; word guard W3)
A store header names a product type in a comment (Design Invariant 9; word guard W1)
mutants.replace: using EntityId = std::uint64_t; // the same as PlayerId
